commitments.detail: Ensure all necessary medical evaluations are completed
Verify patient Alder's authorization status before finalizing the schedule.
Coordinate interpreter services if needed based on patient Alder's language needs.
Confirm oxygen delivery arrangements if required based on patient Alder's medical needs.
Ensure all necessary medical consultations are scheduled.
Assure that social services are aligned with patient needs.
Verify patient eligibility and obtain necessary authorizations.
Ensure patient transportation and any required equipment are arranged.
